title: 다음 곡
suno_analysis_sp: K-Rock with high-energy punk influences. Distorted electric guitars play driving power chords and palm-muted eighth-note patterns. A gritty, aggressive male vocal delivers melodic but strained lines with occasional shouts. The drums feature a heavy backbeat with frequent crash cymbal accents and rapid snare fills. A distorted bass guitar follows the guitar root notes closely. The track is in the key of E Major at 165 BPM in 4/4 time.
